title: The brave fight is inward
summary: True courage subdues the vicious ego within, not another person. Treat ego as illness, not identity.
takeaway: Treat ego as illness, not identity.
lifeApplication: When the face heats or the throat tightens, pause and refuse to grant ego the status of truth.

source.shortMeaning: True courage subdues the vicious ego within, not another person.
source.lifeApplication: When conflict sharpens, fight the ego within before you fight anyone else.

evidence.coreClaim: True courage subdues the vicious ego within, not another person.
evidence.turn: Remember this: measure courage by how deeply ego is subdued.
evidence.practicalImplication: When the face heats or the throat tightens, pause and refuse to grant ego the status of truth.
